saints.name: St. Joseph
saints.summary: Spouse of the Blessed Virgin Mary and guardian of the Holy Family.

saints.name: Blessed Virgin Mary
saints.summary: Mother of God and our spiritual mother.

saints.name: St. Michael the Archangel
saints.summary: Leader of the heavenly armies and protector against evil.

saints.name: St. Anthony of Padua
saints.summary: Franciscan preacher and Doctor of the Church.

saints.name: St. Thérèse of Lisieux
saints.summary: Carmelite nun who taught the Little Way of trust and love.

saints.name: St. Francis of Assisi
saints.summary: Founder of the Franciscans and lover of poverty and creation.

saints.name: St. Jude Thaddeus
saints.summary: Apostle and patron of difficult and desperate cases.

saints.name: St. Peregrine Laziosi
saints.summary: Servite saint invoked for healing, especially from cancer.

saints.name: St. Rita of Cascia
saints.summary: Augustinian nun known as the saint of the impossible.

saints.name: St. Gerard Majella
saints.summary: Redemptorist brother invoked for safe childbirth and motherhood.

saints.name: St. Pio of Pietrelcina
saints.summary: Capuchin friar known for his stigmata and ministry in the confessional.

saints.name: St. Joan of Arc
saints.summary: Virgin and martyr who led France to victory and remained faithful unto death.
